# osc_workspace (Data Source)

Reports the OSC workspace (tenant) and user that the provider's access token belongs to. Every OSC access token is bound to exactly one workspace, and all resources are created in that workspace. Use this to assert where a configuration will be applied, or set `workspace` on the provider to make the provider refuse tokens for any other workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Which workspace and user the provider's token belongs to.
data "osc_workspace" "current" {}

output "workspace" {
  value = data.osc_workspace.current.workspace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `environment` (String) OSC environment the provider talks to.
- `id` (String) Same as workspace.
- `token_expiry` (String) Expiry time of the token in RFC 3339, or empty if it does not expire.
- `token_type` (String) `pat` for a personal access token, `oauth` for a short lived token from `osc login`.
- `user_id` (String) Id of the user the token was issued to.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace (tenant) id the token is bound to.
